018/**
019 * Enhanced Command Factory with optimized integration capabilities.
020 *
021 * <p>This factory extends AbstractFactory to provide enhanced command creation with:
022 *
023 * <ul>
024 *   <li>Intelligent caching with configurable cache policies
025 *   <li>Unified error handling and logging integration
026 *   <li>Performance optimizations for high-throughput scenarios
027 *   <li>Seamless integration with ControllerFactory
028 *   <li>Backward compatibility with existing CommandFactory API
029 * </ul>
030 *
031 * <p>This class addresses Issue #124 by providing optimized integration between CommandFactory and
032 * ControllerFactory, reducing redundancy while maintaining backward compatibility.
033 *
034 * <p>Usage examples:
035 *
036 * <pre>
037 * // Static methods (backward compatible)
038 * IStreamCommand command = EnhancedCommandFactory.createWithLogging(CsvNavigateCommand.class, "name");
039 *
040 * // Instance methods with configuration
041 * EnhancedCommandFactory factory = new EnhancedCommandFactory(FactoryConfiguration.productionConfig());
042 * IStreamCommand cached = factory.createCached(JsonNavigateCommand.class, "$.user");
043 *
044 * // Pipeline creation with optimization
045 * IStreamCommand[] pipeline = factory.createPipelineOptimized(
046 *     CommandConfig.of(CsvNavigateCommand.class, "name"),
047 *     CommandConfig.of(JsonNavigateCommand.class, "$.user.name")
048 * );
049 * </pre>
050 *
051 * @since 1.0
052 */
053public class EnhancedCommandFactory extends AbstractFactory<IStreamCommand> {
054  private static final Logger log = LoggerFactory.getLogger(EnhancedCommandFactory.class);
055
056  /** Default singleton instance for static methods */
057  private static final EnhancedCommandFactory DEFAULT_INSTANCE = new EnhancedCommandFactory();

075  /**

082   * @return command with logging enabled
083   */

085      Class<T> commandClass, Object... args) {

199  // ========== Enhanced Instance Methods ==========

201  /**
202   * Creates command with caching support.
203   *
204   * @param <T> command type
205   * @param commandClass command class
206   * @param args constructor arguments
207   * @return cached or newly created command
208   * @throws FactoryException if creation fails
209   */
210  public <T extends IStreamCommand> T createCached(Class<T> commandClass, Object... args)
211      throws FactoryException {
212    String cacheKey = createCacheKey(commandClass.getName(), args);
213
214    T cached = (T) getCachedInstance(cacheKey);
215    if (cached != null) {
216      log.debug("Retrieved cached command: {} (key: {})", commandClass.getSimpleName(), cacheKey);
217      return cached;
218    }
219
220    T command = createCommandWithLogging(commandClass, config.isDetailedLoggingEnabled(), args);
221    cacheInstance(cacheKey, command);
222    return command;
223  }

254  // ========== Private Implementation Methods ==========
255
256  /**
257   * Creates Navigate command using factory methods if applicable. This method handles the new API
258   * for Navigate commands that no longer have deprecated constructors.
259   *
260   * @param <T> command type
261   * @param commandClass the command class
262   * @param args constructor arguments
263   * @return created command or null if not applicable
264   * @throws FactoryException if creation fails
265   */
266  private <T extends IStreamCommand> Optional<T> createNavigateCommandIfApplicable(
267      Class<T> commandClass, Object... args) throws FactoryException {
268
269    String className = commandClass.getSimpleName();
270
271    if ("JsonNavigateCommand".equals(className)) {
272      return createJsonNavigateCommand(commandClass, args);
273    } else if ("CsvNavigateCommand".equals(className)) {
274      return createCsvNavigateCommand(commandClass, args);
275    } else if ("XmlNavigateCommand".equals(className)) {
276      return createXmlNavigateCommand(commandClass, args);
277    }
278    return Optional.empty();
279  }
280
281  private <T extends IStreamCommand> Optional<T> createJsonNavigateCommand(
282      Class<T> commandClass, Object... args) throws FactoryException {
283    try {
284      // We need to add PassThroughRule as second argument for factory method
285      com.streamConverter.command.rule.PassThroughRule defaultRule =
286          new com.streamConverter.command.rule.PassThroughRule();
287
288      if (args.length == 1) {
289        // Single argument - use create(path, rule)
290        Object path = args[0];
291        return Optional.of(
292            (T) JsonNavigateCommand.create(new JSONPath((String) path), defaultRule));
293      } else if (args.length == 0) {
294        // No arguments - NavigateCommand requires a path
295        throw new IllegalArgumentException(
296            "JsonNavigateCommand requires a JSONPath - cannot create without path");
297      } else if (args.length == 2 && args[1] instanceof com.streamConverter.command.rule.IRule) {
298        // Two arguments (String path, IRule) - use create(path, rule)
299        String path = (String) args[0];
300        com.streamConverter.command.rule.IRule rule =
301            (com.streamConverter.command.rule.IRule) args[1];
302        return Optional.of((T) JsonNavigateCommand.create(new JSONPath(path), rule));
303      } else {
304        // Other argument patterns - throw exception rather than returning empty
305        throw new IllegalArgumentException(
306            "JsonNavigateCommand factory method does not support "
307                + args.length
308                + " arguments of the given types");
309      }
310    } catch (Exception e) {
311      throw new FactoryException("Failed to create JsonNavigateCommand: " + e.getMessage(), e);
312    }
313  }
314

370  /** Core command creation method with logging integration. */
371  private <T extends IStreamCommand> T createCommandWithLogging(
372      Class<T> commandClass, boolean enableDetailedLogging, Object... args)
373      throws FactoryException {
374
375    Optional<T> navigateResult = createNavigateCommandIfApplicable(commandClass, args);
376    if (navigateResult.isPresent()) {
377      T command = navigateResult.get();
378
379      if (config.isDetailedLoggingEnabled() || enableDetailedLogging) {
380        log.info(
381            "Created command instance: {} with {} args (detailed logging: {})",
382            commandClass.getSimpleName(),
383            args.length,
384            enableDetailedLogging);
385      }
386
387      // Handle logging decoration
388      if (command instanceof AbstractStreamCommand) {
389        // AbstractStreamCommand already has integrated logging
390        return command;
391      } else if (enableDetailedLogging) {
392        // Wrap with LoggingDecorator for non-AbstractStreamCommand instances
393        return (T) new LoggingDecorator(command);
394      } else {
395        return command;
396      }
397    } else {
398      T command = createInstance(commandClass, args);
399
400      if (config.isDetailedLoggingEnabled() || enableDetailedLogging) {
401        log.info(
402            "Created command instance: {} with {} args (detailed logging: {})",
403            commandClass.getSimpleName(),
404            args.length,
405            enableDetailedLogging);
406      }
407
408      // Handle logging decoration
409      if (command instanceof AbstractStreamCommand) {
410        // AbstractStreamCommand already has integrated logging
411        return command;
412      } else if (enableDetailedLogging) {
413        // Wrap with LoggingDecorator for non-AbstractStreamCommand instances
414        return (T) new LoggingDecorator(command);
415      } else {
416        return command;
417      }
418    }
419  }
420
421  /** Creates pipeline with specified logging configuration. */
422  private IStreamCommand[] createPipeline(CommandConfig[] configs, boolean enableDetailedLogging)
423      throws FactoryException {
424    List<IStreamCommand> commands = new ArrayList<>();
425
426    log.info(
427        "Creating pipeline with {} commands (detailed logging: {})",
428        configs.length,
429        enableDetailedLogging);
430
431    for (int i = 0; i < configs.length; i++) {
432      CommandConfig config = configs[i];
433      try {
434        IStreamCommand command =
435            createCommandWithLogging(
436                config.getCommandClass(), enableDetailedLogging, config.getArgs());
437        commands.add(command);
438
439        if (log.isDebugEnabled()) {
440          log.debug("Added command {}/{}: {}", i + 1, configs.length, config.getDescription());
441        }
442      } catch (Exception e) {
443        String message =
444            String.format(
445                "Failed to create command %d/%d: %s",
446                i + 1, configs.length, config.getDescription());
447        log.error(message, e);
448
449        if (this.config.isFailFastOnError()) {
450          throw new FactoryException(message, e);
451        }
452        // Continue with next command if fail-fast is disabled
453      }
454    }
455
456    log.info("Created pipeline with {}/{} commands successfully", commands.size(), configs.length);
457    return commands.toArray(new IStreamCommand[0]);
458  }
